title: A worker keeps restarting after a rollout
brief: At 09:10 UTC a thumbnail worker stops completing large jobs after a rollout. The new worker pod has restarted four times.
question: Which evidence explains the restarts, and how would you test whether your change restored processing?

evidence.observation: The worker uses the same image in revisions 7 and 8. Its container memory limit changed from 512Mi to 128Mi.
Under a comparable large job, revision 7 reached 196 MiB. Revision 8 grows to 126 MiB immediately before its last metrics sample.
The worker container has state.waiting.reason=CrashLoopBackOff, lastState.terminated.reason=OOMKilled, exitCode=137 and restartCount=4. Node memory pressure is false.

workedResponse.diagnosis: The revised limit is below the observed memory demand of a large job. The container termination reason and change history support memory exhaustion as the cause of the restart loop.
workedResponse.mitigation: Check available node capacity and restore the known working limit for one worker. Run a representative large job before rolling the change out.
workedResponse.recovery: Verify a large job completes, restarts stop increasing across repeated large jobs, and queue age falls as the worker drains its backlog.
